## Notes

Ubisoft Montpellier, designed by Eric Chahi; Xbox Live Arcade 2011-07-27, Windows 2011-08-17, PSN 2011-09, Chrome 2012-05-23; lava cools to rock, water erodes, vegetation spreads; the Breath cursor; totems and villages; tsunami and eruption warnings; spiritual successor to Populous.
